research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Subtle Medical is researching and developing systems and methods for medical image denoising using deep learning, harmonizing and enhancing medical images, and improving image quality in PET, MRI, and SPECT scans. Their work includes adaptive deep learning for MR image enhancement, contrast dose reduction, real-time video denoising, and automated image quality control. These efforts focus on accelerating imaging, reducing noise, and standardizing images across modalities and vendors.

overview_description.description: Subtle Medical develops software tools that apply deep learning to medical imaging workflows. The company focuses on enhancing image quality and supporting faster imaging protocols in modalities such as MRI and PET. Its products are used to reduce scan time while maintaining diagnostic image quality in clinical settings. The software is integrated into radiology workflows to process and improve images after acquisition or during reconstruction. It is used by healthcare providers and imaging centers to support efficiency in diagnostic imaging processes.

about_short_description.short_description: Subtle Medical provides AI-powered medical imaging software that enhances image quality and efficiency.

product.name: Subtle-ELITE™
product.description: An AI-powered MRI software suite that accelerates image acquisition, enhances image quality, and automates workflow steps for radiology providers.

product.name: SubtleHD™ (MR)
product.description: AI-powered MRI denoising and sharpening software that improves image quality and supports faster MRI sequences on existing scanners.

product.name: SubtleHD™ (PET)
product.description: AI-powered denoising and sharpening software for low-count PET images, supporting shorter scans across PET, PET/CT, and PET/MR systems.

product.name: SubtleHD™ (CT)
product.description: AI-powered CT denoising software that reduces image noise and improves low-contrast detectability on existing CT and PET/CT scanners.

product.name: SubtleSYNTH™
product.description: AI software that generates selected MRI image contrasts, including STIR images, from acquired data to reduce imaging time.

product.name: SubtleALIGN™
product.description: AI software that automates brain MRI alignment to improve consistency and reduce manual positioning and adjustment tasks.
